notes.eagerJsGzipKb: bundle-budget.mjs parses dist/index.html modulepreloads; any preloaded chunk counts as eager.
notes.previewChunkGzipKb: The Preview chunk plus every chunk it imports statically that index.html does not preload, gzipped (bundle-budget.mjs). ADR-0022 point 8: the preview highlights fences through `await import()` of the editor's grammars, so its chunk carries no CodeMirror; a static import would put the ≈100 kB core chunk into this row. Measured 2026-09-21: 3.6 kB (the chunk alone, since every other static import of it is eager).
notes.ciFactors: Per-metric override of ciNoiseFactor, derived from measurement, not guessed. Two dispatched perf runs on macos-latest measured incrementalScan10kNotesMs at 3615 ms and 1168 ms (2026-09-07, runs 34144782352 and 34145006587) against 371 ms on the developer's M-series Mac: a 3x spread between consecutive runs of a cold, IO-bound scan on a shared runner. No threshold at factor 2 both catches a regression and survives an unlucky run, and a gate that fires on noise gets ignored. Factor 6 (9000 ms) sits 2.5x above the worst observed run, so it still catches a catastrophic regression while the real 1500 ms budget stays the number that describes the product. perf-budget.mjs flags any value over the raw budget even when the CI threshold passes, so the loose gate never hides the truth. Revisit when the app-side rows land (Spike C).
notes.keystrokeP50Ms: Measured by hand, not in CI (no runner has a WebView): NOVALIS_PERF=1 or NOVALIS_PERF=type:<n> on the dev app (apps/desktop/ui/src/lib/perf.ts; the burst mode types n characters itself and edits the note, so use a throwaway vault). Three series per keystroke: `work` = keydown until a macrotask posted from it runs (the keystroke's own task and microtasks, unquantised; this is the row's number), `busy` = until the first animation frame (`work` rounded up to the frame; CodeMirror's measure() pass is not in it), `paint` = until the second frame (floor two frames, ≈33 ms at 60 Hz; the double-rAF PLAN.md §11.3 names). In burst mode busy/paint floor at one/two full frames because each keystroke starts right after a frame callback; a human keystroke carries the remainder of its frame instead. 2026-09-20, M-series Mac, 60 Hz, dev build, 120 burst keystrokes per file, work p50/p95: before the lazy text mirror (ADR-0022 F7) 1 MB md 13/14 ms, 5.6 MB txt 50/56, 50 MB log 465/521; after 4/5, 3/5, 4/4. busy/paint after sit at the burst floor (16–17/33) for all three; before, 5.6 MB was 50/66 and 50 MB 467/482.
notes.openNote1MbMs: First numbers 2026-09-20 (same run as keystrokeP50Ms, dev build, tab restored at boot, from bootstrap's answer to the editor painted — includes the editor chunk over the vite dev server and read_file; not the release bundle and not click-to-editable, so not this row's method): 1 MB md 421 → 419 ms, 5.6 MB txt 575 → 538 ms, 50 MB log 2373 → 1861 ms before → after the lazy mirror (the 50 MB gain is the word count no longer running once at open in plain mode). The rows stay unproven until measured on the release bundle.
